name: home_assistant_command
description: Control smart home devices via Home Assistant. Use for lights, switches, fans, climate, locks, TVs, and media players. IMPORTANT: For 'put on Netflix', 'switch to HDMI 1', 'change the input' — always use select_source. LIGHTS RULE: The lights in this home are smart plugs (switch domain) named 'Light 1', 'Light 2', 'Light 3', 'Light 4'. When user says 'lights' use domain='light' — the system auto-finds the switch entities.

parameters.description: The smart home command. 'turn_on'/'turn_off' to toggle devices. 'toggle' to flip state. 'set_brightness' to dim a light. 'set_temperature' to set a thermostat. 'select_source' for TV input/app changes like 'put on Netflix'. 'list_devices' to get all entities and states.
Home Assistant entity ID if known, e.g. 'light.living_room', 'media_player.lg_tv'. Optional — system resolves by friendly_name if omitted.
Human-readable device name to find, e.g. 'living room light', 'bedroom fan'. Use when you don't know the entity_id.
Target temperature for 'set_temperature', e.g. 'set thermostat to 72' → 72.
Required for 'select_source'. The TV input or app name: 'Netflix', 'Hulu', 'HDMI 1', 'HDMI 2', 'YouTube', etc.

HA domain to scope a broad command: 'light', 'switch', 'climate', 'fan', 'media_player', 'lock', 'sensor'. Use 'light' when user talks about lights — the system will also find switch entities named 'Light 1–4' automatically.
